data.title: Elysium DEX Trading Volume Surpasses $1 Billion
data.description: Total trading volume on decentralized exchanges on Elysium has surpassed $1 billion. According to Foresight News, the Layer 2 network said in a post on X that its DEX trading volume had crossed the threshold.

data.title: Binance to Offer 1,000 USDC for Two Blockchain Week Challenges
data.description:
According to the announcement from Binance, two challenges tied to Binance Blockchain Week Bangkok will give participants a chance to share a total prize pool of 1,000 USDC in token vouchers. The activities invite the global community to share event experiences and recognize Binance Community Heroes.

The activity period runs from 2026-11-28 01:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-30 23:59 (UTC). Each challenge has a prize pool of 500 USDC in token vouchers.

For more information, please refer to Binance's official announcements.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Herman Jin: AI Is Not Broken, Liquidity Is; Semiconductor Turning Point May Come in Q1 2027
data.description: Former Goldman Sachs FICC executive Herman Jin said the AI and semiconductor pullback was driven by volatility in long-term interest rates that triggered credit tightening, rather than evidence that AI demand had weakened. According to PANews, Jin is watching for extreme positioning in Q1 2027 and demand validation from Vera Rubin.

data.title: Jeff Park: This Is the Toughest Bitcoin Cycle I Have Experienced
data.description: Jeff Park said this is the toughest Bitcoin cycle he has experienced. According to PANews, he said institutional trust is declining and surveillance is expanding, while Bitcoin has yet to chart an independent performance. Park said Bitcoin never promised a particular price, correlation, or catalyst; its promise was a permissionless alternative based on a fixed supply, censorship-resistant settlement, and ownership that does not depend on another party’s authorization. He said that promise remains intact and that Bitcoin is worth continuing to hold.

data.title: Deutsche Bank: Tech Selloff May Be Nearing Bottom as S&P 500 Is Forecast to Rise 25% to 9,000
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Deutsche Bank, the bank expects the S&P 500 to reach 9,000 by the end of 2027, up more than 25% from current levels, in its latest 2027 global outlook. That is the most bullish target among major Wall Street investment banks. Deutsche Bank says the technology stock selloff that began in mid-October may be nearing its end; similar market swings have historically taken an average of six to eight weeks to form a bottom.

The bank expects AI capital spending to continue supporting U.S. economic growth and corporate earnings. It forecasts 2027 earnings per share of $430 for S&P 500 companies, a 19% year-over-year increase. While capital spending growth by hyperscale cloud providers may peak next year, Deutsche Bank expects AI adoption and monetization to accelerate earnings growth. It projects those providers’ capital spending will rise from about $1 trillion in 2026 to $1.35 trillion in 2027.

Deutsche Bank expects AI investment, housing inflation, and resilient demand to slow the decline in inflation. It says the Federal Reserve may raise rates by 25 basis points in December 2026, January 2027, and March 2027, bringing the federal funds rate to 4.50%–4.75%. The bank also forecasts the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield will reach 5.05% by the end of 2027.

Deutsche Bank’s equity strategy team is bullish on technology stocks and U.S. equities. Its credit strategy team cautions that slower AI capital spending could pose market risks and recommends hedging with S&P 500 put options, while underweighting chipmakers, newer cloud computing companies, and data center-related credit assets.

data.title: SpaceX Shares Rise More Than 7% on Blue Ocean ATS After Musk Expands Donation Plan
data.description:
SpaceX shares rose more than 7% in overnight trading on Blue Ocean ATS after Elon Musk expanded his plan to donate shares to children in the United States. According to Odaily, Musk said he would donate an additional SpaceX share every year to every child in the country.

Blue Ocean ATS is an alternative trading system for U.S. stocks that operates from 8 p.m. to 4 a.m. Eastern time, outside regular market hours. Its holiday schedule says overnight trading will resume at 8 p.m. Eastern time on Thanksgiving.

data.title: STOCKS | South Korea’s KOSPI Rises 4% to 4,899.71; SK Hynix Gains 5%
data.description: South Korea’s KOSPI index rose 4% to 4,899.71 points. According to Odaily, SK Hynix gained 5%, while Samsung Electronics rose more than 4%.

data.title: China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN to Form Working Group on Cross-Border Payments and Crypto Regulation
data.description:
China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN members have agreed to establish a working group on cross-border digital payments and digital asset regulation. According to Odaily, finance ministry and central bank deputies met in Kyoto, Japan, this week and agreed to establish an ASEAN+3 Macroeconomic Research Office (AMRO) cross-border digital payment project and a dedicated group to advance policy discussions, according to a joint statement released Thursday.

The decision follows a meeting in Uzbekistan in May this year, where the parties identified cross-border digital payments as a new area for cooperation and called for a specific cooperation mechanism by the end of 2026. Discussions will focus on connecting retail and wholesale payment systems and on a regulatory framework for stablecoins.

Finance ministers and central bank governors are expected to continue discussing the issues at their next meeting in Nagoya, Japan, in May 2027.

data.title: Binance to Support 0G (0G) BEP20 Contract Swap at a 1:1 Ratio
data.description:
According to the announcement from Binance, the exchange will support a contract swap for 0G (0G) on the BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) network at a 1:1 ratio. Binance will handle the technical requirements for users involved in the swap.

At 2026-11-30 15:00 (UTC), Binance will suspend deposits and withdrawals of 0G tokens via the old BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) network. The old 0G (BEP20) tokens will no longer be supported for deposits or withdrawals after that time. Binance will open deposits and withdrawals for the new 0G (BEP20) tokens once the swap is complete, without further notice.

Spot, Margin, Futures trading and Binance Earn services will not be affected during the contract swap.

The new 0G token contract address on the BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) network is 0G (0x2C2d4d99F95643C8EC2EbD1d73a6Fd0273068B1e). The old 0G token contract address on the network is 0G (0x4B948d64dE1F71fCd12fB586f4c776421a35b3eE).

For more information, please refer to Binance's official announcements.

data.title: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Could Be Worth 1 Million Times the Global Economy
data.description: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk outlined a long-term valuation scenario for the company on social media Thursday. According to Odaily, Musk said SpaceX could be worth about 1 million times the current size of the global economy if it enables life to spread to multiple planets and harnesses one-millionth of the Sun’s energy. He acknowledged that achieving those goals would be extremely difficult but said a path exists. Musk had also said he would donate an additional SpaceX share each year to every child in the United States.

data.title: Kleros Releases Skills 2.5, Enabling AI Agents to Create Disputes
data.description: Kleros has released Skills 2.5, enabling AI agents to create disputes on Kleros Court V2 on Arbitrum One. According to Foresight News, the decentralized dispute-resolution protocol said the new kleros-create-dispute skill can generate disputes from short descriptions, draft questions for juror votes, upload arbitration rules to IPFS, and display all voting options before a user signs with their wallet.

data.title: 3X Long Labubu Reenters Long Positions in Gold and Silver After Gold Reclaims $3,500
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, trader 3X Long Labubu (@labubu_trader) said on X that they had reentered gold and silver after gold moved back above the $3,500 level they had been watching.

The trader said the current entry carries high risk, so they opened only very small positions. They will wait for signals from the Federal Open Market Committee’s December meeting before considering a bet on a larger short squeeze.

The trader added that further gains in precious metals would require the Federal Reserve to end its current rate-hiking cycle in the first quarter or first half of 2027.

data.title: Copper Extends Rebound From 11-Month Low as Asian Tech Stocks Rise
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Bloomberg, copper extended its rebound from an 11-month low, rising alongside Asian technology stocks. Risk appetite recovered after weeks of volatility fueled by concerns about artificial intelligence trades, as investors returned to risk assets after several days of steep declines.

Three-month copper futures on the London Metal Exchange rose 1.9% on Thursday, narrowing the sharp losses recorded earlier this month. The declines had been linked to concerns about AI trades and expectations of an upcoming U.S. interest rate hike. All six base metals on the exchange rose that day, a U.S. public holiday.

data.title: Brazil's CVM DLT Pilot Advances Securities Tokenization; CertiK Assesses ABToken Project
data.description:
CertiK is conducting a security assessment of ABToken’s multichain project under Brazil’s securities tokenization pilot, covering smart contracts, key management and custody. According to Odaily, the project has submitted a proposal to the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) DLT pilot program to explore securities tokenization across blockchain networks. Coordinated by ABToken, the project brings together financial institutions and technology service providers, including CertiK.

For regulators, security assessments of pilot projects need to cover the full system, including smart contracts, transaction authorization keys, asset custody and supporting applications, and identify weaknesses in connections between systems. CertiK will test security controls against specific pilot use cases to help participants understand how security issues could affect operations.

CVM established the DLT pilot program under Resolution No. 249 to assess the technical and operational feasibility, network interoperability and potential risks of experimental securities activities. The ABToken multichain project was one of 11 proposals CVM announced it had received on November 6; the proposals are under review. CertiK expressed appreciation for the pilot’s opportunities for industry exploration and exchange, and for ABToken’s work coordinating institutions and collaborating with participating companies.

CertiK previously completed an independent security assessment for an unnamed licensed RWA tokenization and trading platform, focusing on links between its application systems and on-chain transactions. The assessment covered its web and mobile applications, backend APIs and smart contract components, and supported its annual penetration-testing requirements and establishment of a security baseline.

data.title: Japan's JPCrypto-ISAC and SEAL Sign MOU to Strengthen Cryptocurrency Hacking Response
data.description: Japan's cryptocurrency industry cybersecurity information-sharing organization JPCrypto-ISAC and blockchain security organization Security Alliance (SEAL) signed a memorandum of understanding. According to Foresight News, citing NADA NEWS, the agreement will advance cyberattack information sharing, help affected companies obtain expert support, and establish a network of SEAL-certified responders.

data.title: Arthur Hayes Says Flop Labs Is Expanding Resources as Testnet Traffic Grows
data.description: Arthur Hayes said the Flop testnet is active and traffic continues to grow. According to Odaily, the Flop Labs team is expanding resources to handle increased access demand.

data.title: Bank of Japan Launches DLT Sandbox to Test Cross-Border Payments and Joins Agorá Project
data.description:
The Bank of Japan has launched a distributed ledger technology (DLT) connectivity sandbox to test cross-border payments, interbank settlement and trading of tokenized Japanese government bonds, and is participating in the Agorá project.

According to Odaily, Bank of Japan Executive Director Kazushige Kamiyama said at an International Monetary Fund seminar that stablecoins and tokenized deposits may coexist in the future. He said reserve assets and operating structures for stablecoins and other new forms of money require appropriate oversight and carefully designed connections to central bank money to maintain financial stability.

Kamiyama said inadequate regulation and interoperability could fragment financial markets. Central bank money should remain the foundation of trust in the financial system, enabling different forms of money to be exchanged at par and ensuring final settlement. He also cited liquidity fragmentation, automated clearing amplifying market volatility, cybersecurity threats and legal uncertainty as potential risks of DLT and tokenization. The Agorá project explores wholesale cross-border payments.

data.title: Solana Playground Launches for Browser-Based Program Learning and Development
data.description: Solana Playground has launched, allowing users to learn, develop and deploy Solana programs in a browser. According to Odaily, Solana said in a post on X that AI agents can explain code and help users edit it.

data.title: PEPE Becomes Fifth-Largest Asset in Justin Sun's Wallet, Surpassing His WLFI Holdings
data.description: PEPE is currently the fifth-largest asset in Justin Sun's wallet, with a holding valued at about $26 million. According to Odaily, on-chain data show that the position exceeds Sun's WLFI holdings. Analysis speculated that Sun may be holding the PEPE on someone else's behalf or may have received compensation under a related arrangement, but neither possibility has been confirmed.
